scope: Assigned changed server-mode pairs only; existing images, no new captures or product edits.
method: Tolerance-16 pixel-difference bounding box plus 40 px context, clipped to source edges. Native unless crop exceeds 780 px wide. Main left, candidate right; labelled identity, screen, state, width and theme. At most two pairs per sheet; one extra native detail for 1857.
limits: Existing still images do not establish interaction behavior or whether a loading state eventually settles.
Wide diff regions were downscaled as permitted; exact scales and source-coordinate crops are recorded per pair.
This assigned subset cannot establish coverage for every main feature or complete T076.
open_regressions: 1857: missing visible Git remotes rows; persistent failure versus capture timing unresolved.
